title: Civil maintenance of Lighthouse tower, repair of allied structure and improvement works of Sir Hugh Rose Lighthouse Station
summary: Item-rate e-tender (re-tender) for civil maintenance of the lighthouse tower, repair of allied structures and improvement works at Sir Hugh Rose Lighthouse, Andaman & Nicobar Islands, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Port Blair.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Port Blair

sites.name: Sir Hugh Rose island (Sir Hugh Rose Lighthouse Station)
sites.work: Civil maintenance of lighthouse tower, repair of allied structure and improvement works

scope.item: Civil maintenance of Lighthouse tower, repair of allied structure and improvement works

money.notes: Bid document free of cost. EMD by deposit at call receipt/FDR of any RBI approved nationalised/scheduled bank (Hindi also allows bank guarantee) in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Port Blair, valid 06 months from technical bid opening; originals with technical documents by 08/01/2024 15:00. MSME/NSIC bidders registered for similar work eligible for EMD exemption.

period.bid_validity: 180 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Eligible experienced civil contractors with successful completion of similar civil works including construction/maintenance of buildings, compound wall, towers, pathways etc. in Andaman & Nicobar Islands with Government organizations, without adverse remarks
Detailed eligibility as per Section-III clause 3.1 of tender document (not included)
notes: Section-I NIT (re-tender): pages 1-3 Hindi, 4-6 English; no BOQ. Technical opening subject to internet availability.
